install: set -euo pipefail; if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg; else apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg; fi; fi; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python3 ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi; .venv/bin/pip install --no-input -r requirements.txt; .venv/bin/pip install --no-input --no-deps onnxruntime silero-vad; touch ~/.bashrc; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; VENV_LINE="export PATH=\"$(pwd)/.venv/bin:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$VENV_LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$VENV_LINE" >> ~/.bashrc
